bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 $126–132，测试 5 日均线

read.en: SpaceX rose 8.6% on Nov 6 to $134.27, trading between $128.57 and $135.32; there is no 200-day yet (103 sessions). It closed at the falling 5-day ($134.3) and below the falling 10-day ($139.1) and 30-day ($149.7) averages and the 100-day ($143.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($152.70), and RSI is 42.
read.zh: SpaceX 11月6日上涨 8.6%，收于 $134.27，盘中区间 $128.57–135.32；上市仅 103 个交易日，尚无 200 日均线。股价收于下行的 5 日均线（$134.3）附近，位于下行的 10 日（$139.1）和 30 日均线（$149.7）以及 100 日均线（$143.9）下方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$152.70），RSI 为 42。

read.en: The jump reclaimed the $125.3–126.7 and $130.2–131.9 levels lost on Nov 5, support again, and stopped at the $134.3–135.3 zone (5-day, Oct 30 low, Nov 6 high). Resistance is $134.3–135.3, then $139.1–141.3 (10-day, Nov 3 close) and $143.9 (100-day). Support is $130.2–131.9, then $125.3–126.7 and $120.4 (Nov 5 low). A close above $135.3 would target $139–141; below $130.2, $126.

s.en: Aug 10 and Aug 20 lows ($130.2–130.4); Nov 5 high $131.87, reclaimed
